content.text:
else:
            ti = bisect_right(tedges, t - slot_anchor[s]) - 1
            cj = bisect_right(cedges, backlog) - 1
            if draw >= prob[ti][cj]:
                dec = "probability"
            elif credit < rate_den:
                dec = "tokens"
            elif pending >= pend_cap:
                dec = "queue"
            else:
                dec = "sent"

        if dec == "sent":
            credit -= rate_den
            rows = tuple(win)
            res = cnn_cache.get(rows)
            if res is None:
                res = cnn(rows)
                cnn_cache[rows] = res
            logits, pred = res
            lane = 0
            av = lane_avail[0]
            for x in range(1, L):
                vx = lane_avail[x]
                if vx < av:
                    av = vx
                    lane = x
            start = t if t > av else av
            done = start + service[pred]
            lane_avail[lane] = done
            job_id = next_job
            next_job += 1
            pending += 1
            heapq.heappush(heap, (done, job_id))
            jobs.append({
                "id": job_id,
                "packet": idx,
                "connection": conn_ids[ci],
                "slot": s,
                "generation": gen,
                "lane": lane,
                "start": start,
                "done": done,
                "window": [[r >> 4, r & 15] for r in rows],
                "logits": list(logits),
                "prediction": pred,
                "status": "",
            })
            job_meta.append((s, ci, gen))
            slot_anchor[s] = t
            slot_backlog[s] = 0

        ap({
            "index": idx,
            "connection": conn_ids[ci],
            "generation": gen,
            "forward": fwd,
            "decision": dec,
            "credit": credit,
            "job": job_id,
        })

    # final drain
    while heap:
        _done, jid = heapq.heappop(heap)
        js, jci, jgen = job_meta[jid]
        jb = jobs[jid]
        if slot_occ[js] != jci or slot_gen[js] != jgen:
            jb["status"] = "stale"
        elif jid <= slot_applied[js]:
            jb["status"] = "superseded"
        else:
            jb["status"] = "applied"
            slot_cached[js] = jb["prediction"]
            slot_applied[js] = jid

    # connection accounting
    out_conns = []
    predictions = [None] * nconn
    for ci in range(nconn):
        v = votes[ci]
        if pcount[ci] > 0:
            best = 0
            top = v[0]
            for c in range(1, C):
                if v[c] > top:
                    top = v[c]
                    best = c
            predictions[ci] = best
        out_conns.append({
            "id": conn_ids[ci],
            "split": p["conn_split"][ci],
            "label": p["conn_label"][ci],
            "packets": pcount[ci],
            "votes": list(v),
            "prediction": predictions[ci],
        })

    reports = {}
    for split in ("dev", "eval"):
        conf = [[0] * C for _ in range(C)]
        observed = 0
        for ci in range(nconn):
            if pcount[ci] > 0 and p["conn_split"][ci] == split:
                observed += 1
                conf[p["conn_label"][ci]][predictions[ci]] += 1
        total = Fraction(0)
        for c in range(C):
            tp = conf[c][c]
            col = 0
            for r in range(C):
                col += conf[r][c]
            row = sum(conf[c])
            fp = col - tp
            fn = row - tp
            den = 2 * tp + fp + fn
            if den:
                total += Fraction(2 * tp, den)
        macro = total / C
        reports[split] = {
            "connections": observed,
            "confusion": conf,
            "macro_f1": [macro.numerator, macro.denominator],
        }

    return {
        "packets": out_packets,
        "jobs": jobs,
        "connections": out_conns,
        "reports": reports,
    }


def main():
    text = ERROR_JSON
    try:
        data = sys.stdin.buffer.read(MAX_INPUT_BYTES + 1)
        if len(data) > MAX_INPUT_BYTES:
            raise Invalid("input too large")
        try:
            raw = data.decode("utf-8")
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            raise Invalid("input is not valid UTF-8")
        doc = json.loads(raw, object_pairs_hook=_pairs_hook,
                         parse_constant=_bad_number, parse_float=_bad_number)
        text = json.dumps(replay(validate(doc)), separators=(",", ":"),
                          ensure_ascii=True)
    except BaseException:
        # Any malformed, out-of-contract or unexpected condition collapses to
        # the single required error document; nothing partial is emitted.
        text = ERROR_JSON
